_comment: Generated for Pterodactyl Panel. The installer pulls and runs the repository standalone setup script.
name: EaglerXServer Standalone
author: EaglerXServer contributors
description: Standalone Eaglercraft WebSocket proxy installed with the repository setup script.
startup: cd 'eagler connection' && exec java -Xms128M -Xmx{{SERVER_MEMORY}}M -jar EaglerXServer-Standalone.jar velocity.toml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y curl jq
release_json=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/Cleint123/eaglersetup/releases/latest)
asset_url=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name | test("^EaglerXServer-Standalone.*[.]jar$")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$asset_url" ] || [ "$asset_url" = null ]; then
  echo 'No standalone JAR asset was found in the latest GitHub release.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -fL --retry 3 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cleint123/eaglersetup/main/eaglerweb/setup.sh -o /tmp/eaglerxserver-setup.sh
cd /mnt/server
export EAGLERXSERVER_STANDALONE_JAR_URL="$asset_url"
export SERVER_PORT BACKEND_NAME BACKEND_HOST BACKEND_PORT
printf '3\n%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\nn\n\n5\n' "$SERVER_PORT" "$BACKEND_NAME" "$BACKEND_HOST" "$BACKEND_PORT" | sh /tmp/eaglerxserver-setup.sh

variables.name: Backend Name
variables.description: Name used for the default backend in velocity.toml.

variables.name: Backend Host
variables.description: Backend server hostname or IP address.
